sections.overview: Cymbal is a fast-growing online retailer selling a broad assortment of products across several retail sub-verticals. The sheer breadth of its catalog makes catalog management an ongoing challenge.
sections.solutionConcept: Cymbal wants to modernize operations and improve the customer experience in three areas: (1) **Catalog and content enrichment** using gen AI to generate product attributes, descriptions, and images from supplier-provided data, reducing manual effort and errors and keeping information consistent across channels; (2) **Conversational commerce with product discovery** by adding AI-powered virtual agents to the website and mobile app that use Google Cloud Discovery AI to understand natural-language requests and surface the most relevant products; and (3) **Technical stack modernization** to cut costs around manual processes, data transfer, and error handling through cloud-based infrastructure, secure data handling, third-party integrations, and proactive monitoring and security.
sections.existingTech:
- A blend of **on-premises and cloud-based** systems.
- Multiple databases for the catalog and customer data: **MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, and MongoDB**.
- **Kubernetes clusters** running containerized applications.
- Legacy **file-based integrations** with on-prem systems, including SFTP transfers and ETL batch processing.
- A custom web app that lets customers browse the catalog by querying relational databases for product names and categories.
- An **IVR system** that handles incoming calls and routes them to the right department or agent.
- **Call-center agents** who take transferred calls and manually key in orders when customers cannot self-serve.
- Open source monitoring tools including **Grafana, Nagios, and Elastic**.
- Known pain points: manual processes are slow and error-prone, data silos block a unified customer view, and integrating new technology is hard.
businessReqs: Automate product catalog enrichment to cut manual effort, reduce errors, and keep the catalog accurate and consistent.
Improve product discoverability with better search relevance so customers find products more efficiently.
Increase customer engagement through a more interactive, personalized shopping experience that lifts satisfaction and may reduce returns.
Drive sales conversion with a more intuitive, helpful shopping experience that grows revenue.
Reduce costs, specifically call-center staffing and data-center hosting costs.
technicalReqs: Attribute generation: derive accurate product attributes from varied supplier data (titles, descriptions, images) aligned to the product category and Cymbal's existing catalog structure.
Image generation and enhancement: produce image variations from a base image (e.g., color variants), with support for background changes, color adjustments, and text overlays.
Automate product discovery: interpret natural-language customer requests and return highly relevant results.
Scalability and performance: handle the large catalog and anticipated growth without degrading performance or experience.
Human-in-the-loop (HITL) review: give associates a UI to approve, reject, or edit gen AI-generated content before it updates the catalog.
Data security and compliance: handle all customer data and virtual-agent interactions securely and in line with relevant industry regulations.
sections.executiveStatement: By adopting Google Cloud's generative AI for digital commerce, Cymbal expects to lower operational costs, speed up product onboarding, improve information accuracy and consistency, deliver a more engaging conversational shopping experience, and boost discoverability and conversion. This investment is meant to keep Cymbal competitive in a fast-evolving online retail market.
